reason: I pay a robo-adviser maybe eight bucks a month in fees and that already feels like plenty, so I'm not adding a subscription with no price on it yet just to have a cute pet do roughly the same rebalancing. A waitlist for a paid plan with an unknown price is a no from me.
objection: It's a brand-new app that wants an AI to move my real money and connect to a broker that isn't even named yet. I'd want to know who holds my account and my data before I hand over anything.
would_change_my_mind: A real-money version with no monthly fee, or one that costs less than my robo-adviser all-in, through a named, SIPC-insured broker.
